decisions.reason: Although still promoted on the home page in 2024, the accelerator is the most peripheral to the firm's machinery-centered core, so under a behavioral logic it would be kept for now but is the easiest candidate to cut if its contribution falls short of aspiration levels or slack tightens.

As a flagship product that remained on its own page through 2024 and fits the firm's circular-economy narrative, management would likely tolerate some uncertainty and keep investing unless performance clearly disappoints relative to aspirations.

Because this decontamination plant is both close to the established technical offer and still featured prominently in 2024, it is likely meeting or staying close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support.
